jobs.occupation: (Senior) Consultant Data & Analytics - People Advisory Services (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Requisition ID: 1654941Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.Your roleBy joining the People Advisory Services service line, you'll be part of a fast-growing team that helps multinational companies manage compliance for short-term business travel. Your work sits between our clients and the technology teams behind EY's Business Travel Compliance software. You will take on a wide range of tasks:- Work directly with clients to manage master data in the EY Business Travel Compliance software across technical environments (e.g., test and production), with a focus on data quality and standardization.- Build and improve automated data flows, including data migrations between environments.- Create reports and dashboards that give clients visibility into their data quality and travel compliance.- Prepare and lead Data & Analytics workshops with clients to understand their requirements and turn them into data and integration solutions.- Support API integrations with client systems and analyze data-related bugs through to resolution.- Act as the link between business and tech by coordinating with Product Owners, Testing, and Content teams, as well as the Backend, Frontend, and RPA teams.Your skillset- You write production-quality SQL and Python, and you're just as comfortable in a client workshop working out what needs to be built. This isn't pure development or pure reporting. The role is at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and consulting.- University degree in computer science, business informatics, economics, mathematics, or a related field, combined with relevant professional experience.- Strong technical and analytical skills, including SQL, Python, ETL pipelines, APIs, and experience with clean, tested, modular, and version-controlled code (e.g., Git/GitHub, Azure DevOps).- Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or SAP Analytics Cloud, as well as advanced Excel skills, including Power Query.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience translating business requirements into technical solutions; fluent German and English (C1 level or higher).Your mindset- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export control requirementsRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box or master every topic from day one. If the core is there and you have the drive to grow into the rest, we want to hear from you.Must Have- 5+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware and PCB development- Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, or a comparable technical foundation- A track record of independently taking PCBs from schematic to manufacturing release: boards you designed that went into production- Strong schematic design and component selection skills, working confidently from datasheets- Strong PCB layout skills on multilayer and high-density boards, including blind and buried vias, built on a solid understanding of grounding, power distribution, differential interfaces, controlled impedance, and high-speed design- Practical understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly, including direct work with manufacturers on stack-ups, fabrication rules, assembly requirements, and production issues- Hands-on lab skills: board bring-up, debugging, lab equipment, soldering, and rework- Strong experience in at least one professional ECAD environment, such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens Xpedition, or comparable. - Ownership mindset: you drive designs forward without continuous supervision, and an undocumented design change is a problem for you, not a shortcut- Fluent English (German is a plus)- Willingness to undergo security vetting where projects require it- Based in Munich or willing to relocateNice to Have- Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, which our existing products are built on- Experience with BOM management or component lifecycle tools- RF and wireless electronics or communication systems, the core of what we build- Ethernet and high-speed digital interfaces, power electronics, or embedded systems- EMC/EMI-conscious design and experience taking products through EMC and radio certification (CE/RED)- Electronics for robotics, UAVs, or other ruggedized systems, ideally in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment- Connector selection, wiring harness, and pinout definition- Scripting or engineering automationAbout usWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- Compensation. We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)

jobs.description: Job available in 10 locations: Frankfurt, Dresden, Düsseldorf, Munich, Leipzig, Stuttgart, Remote, Nurnberg, Hamburg, BerlinWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOffice, Various outside weather conditionsJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.Our Clinical Next-Generation Sequencing Division (CSD) is committed to making next-generation sequencing (NGS) technologies more accessible to researchers and healthcare professionals worldwide.Through our innovative Ion Torrent technologies and solutions in oncology, reproductive health, and clinical genomics, we help customers accelerate scientific discoveries, streamline workflows, and advance precision medicine.Location:Remote-based role in Germany with regular travel across the region and close collaboration with local commercial teams.Discover Impactful WorkMarket Development Manager – Clinical Next-Generation SequencingCentral Region | EMEA Marketing | 1 year Fixed-Term ContractHelp shape the future of clinical genomics by connecting scientific innovation with customer needs and commercial opportunities.We are looking for a commercially minded and customer-focused Market Development Manager to join our EMEA Marketing Team on a fixed-term contract.In this highly collaborative, field-oriented role, you will drive market development and demand generation for our clinical NGS portfolio across the Central Region.Working closely with sales, regional marketing, and clinical stakeholders, you will translate European marketing strategies into impactful local initiatives, identify growth opportunities, and accelerate customer engagement and technology adoption.This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strategic marketing thinking with hands-on commercial execution and enjoys working directly with customers and field teams to make a measurable business impact.A Day in the Life:As Market Development Manager, you will take ownership of local market development initiatives, connecting market insights, customer needs, and commercial priorities to drive sustainable growth.Your key responsibilities will include:- Drive market development strategy: Translate European and regional priorities into targeted local marketing plans, identifying high-potential customer segments, applications, and growth opportunities.- Partner with sales to accelerate growth: Work alongside commercial teams to strengthen customer engagement, develop compelling value propositions, and generate qualified opportunities.- Execute impactful marketing campaigns: Adapt and deliver integrated campaigns, product launches, and customer engagement initiatives tailored to local market needs.- Build scientific and customer relationships: Engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinical stakeholders, and influential customers to support education, advocacy, and adoption of clinical NGS solutions.- Create meaningful customer experiences: Plan and execute webinars, scientific meetings, workshops, congress activities, and peer-to-peer programs that drive awareness and demand.- Turn market insights into action: Monitor customer needs, competitive developments, and market trends to identify opportunities and continuously improve commercial activities.- Measure and optimize performance: Track campaign effectiveness, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and return on marketing investment to maximize business impact.What to expect:- A high-impact, field-oriented marketing role with strong visibility across sales, marketing, and regional commercial leadership.- Close collaboration with sales teams through customer visits, account planning, field coaching, and targeted demand-generation activities.- Opportunities to work with clinical experts, scientific societies, and influential customers in the evolving field of precision medicine.- Responsibility for translating customer and market insights into practical commercial initiatives.- Ownership of marketing activities from planning and execution through performance evaluation and optimization.- A dynamic, international environment where collaboration, initiative, and commercial creativity are valued.Keys to Success:Education- A degree in Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Marketing, Business, or a related field is advantageous.Experience- Demonstrated experience in market development, commercial marketing, product marketing, or a comparable customer-facing commercial role.- Experience working closely with sales teams to develop demand, engage customers, and support business growth.- Experience in life sciences, molecular diagnostics, clinical genomics, or related healthcare markets is highly desirable.- Experience delivering marketing campaigns, customer events, or commercial programs and evaluating their impact.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate market opportunities into actionable growth initiatives.- Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage sales teams, scientific stakeholders, and customers.- Ability to develop compelling customer value propositions and communicate complex scientific solutions clearly.- Strong analytical, organizational, and project-management skills, with a results-oriented approach.- Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across functions and countries.- Fluent business English and German are non negotiable; additional relevant European languages are an advantage.- Willingness to travel regularly across the Central Region and spend meaningful time with customers and field teams.Competencies- Commercial acumen: Understands customer needs and identifies opportunities to accelerate market adoption and revenue growth.- Customer focus: Builds strong relationships and translates customer insights into relevant solutions and activities.- Collaboration and influence: Works effectively across sales, marketing, and scientific functions to achieve shared goals.- Strategic thinking with hands-on execution: Connects business priorities with practical, high-impact activities.- Results orientation: Takes ownership, measures impact, and continuously improves performance.- Adaptability and initiative: Thrives in a dynamic environment and proactively identifies new opportunities.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.
